extensionDescription.message: A Firefox sidebar for MiniMax-M3 by MiniMax. Chat, ask about the page or selection, summarize, and rewrite — all from the sidebar.

cmdToggleSidebar.description: Keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.

cmdAskSelection.description: Keyboard shortcut to ask about the selected text.

cmdSummarizePage.description: Keyboard shortcut to summarize the page.

cmdNewChat.description: Keyboard shortcut to start a new chat.
